277257286.description:
Mineral Specimen Collection - Mixed Lot
Quartz, Calcite, and Various Natural Stones
Natural Geological Specimens
This collection features a variety of natural geological specimens, anchored by a significant large white geode with a visible crystalline interior. These pieces offer a range of textures, from raw, jagged mineral clusters to smooth tumbled accent stones, making them ideal for display, geological study, or as a foundational set for a mineral collection. The diverse array of colors and formations provides a comprehensive look at common mineral structures including druzy quartz and calcite cleavage planes.
Pieces Included:
Large white quartz geode, approximately 6.5 inches tall with hollow crystalline center
Medium raw mineral specimens (2) featuring layered crystal structures and earthy inclusions
Yellow raw and tumbled stones (4) with vibrant saturation
Green tumbled stone (1) with semi-translucent appearance
Clear and smoky mineral accent pieces (multiple) in various sizes
White flat mineral slab (1) with matte finish
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in raw and tumbled states. The large geode is intact as a specimen half with well-defined internal crystals. Smaller pieces show typical natural variations, inclusions, and fractures inherent to mineral formations. No significant modern damage beyond natural extraction characteristics. Total collection weight is 5.14 pounds.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland

277591027.description:
Crystal and Mineral Specimen Collection
Natural Shaped and Rough Stones
Total Weight: 4.87 lbs
This comprehensive collection features a diverse array of geological specimens, encompassing both raw natural forms and professionally shaped decorative pieces. The set is anchored by a 5-inch amethyst obelisk showing deep violet saturation and geometric precision. The lot includes polished spheres, raw rose quartz, and a unique oyster shell with a small pearl. These stones represent a variety of mineral groups and geological formations, suitable for display, study, or metaphysical use.
5-inch tall faceted amethyst obelisk tower with sharp termination
Selection includes raw rose quartz, clear quartz points, and black mineral towers
Tumbled malachite specimen exhibiting characteristic green banding patterns
Polished sandstone and jasper spheres with unique sedimentary patterning
Natural oyster shell with integrated small pearl accent
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. As natural mineral specimens, these pieces feature inherent inclusions, surface textures, and natural fractures typical of geological materials. The amethyst obelisk and polished spheres maintain smooth finishes and sharp edges. All stones are clean and well-preserved. Total weight of 4.87 lbs verified by scale.
